about: Front ES1/ES2: Spanish strings that may equal their English source, each with a reason (plan §3.2 item 4). Keys: `catalog:<key>`, `map:<id>.<path>`, `original:<normalised original>`.

entries.catalog:app.name: product name (OpenVireo)
entries.map:languageChoice.legend: bilingual on purpose so either reader finds the selector
entries.map:languageChoice.english: each language is named in its own language
entries.map:languageChoice.spanish: each language is named in its own language
entries.catalog:siteClock.utValue: only placeholders, units and glyphs (no words)
entries.catalog:siteClock.hoursValue: only placeholders, units and glyphs (no words)
entries.catalog:runningClock.coordinateValue: only placeholders, units and glyphs (no words)
entries.catalog:horizon.degrees: only placeholders, units and glyphs (no words)
entries.catalog:motion.rateOption: only placeholders, units and glyphs (no words)
entries.catalog:htl.row: only placeholders, units and glyphs (no words)
entries.catalog:cameraParameters.adUpGlyph: an arrow glyph on a button (no words)
entries.catalog:cameraParameters.adDownGlyph: an arrow glyph on a button (no words)
entries.map:camera.filterNames.1: a photometric band name (B, V, R, I)
entries.map:camera.filterNames.2: a photometric band name (B, V, R, I)
entries.map:camera.filterNames.3: a photometric band name (B, V, R, I)
entries.map:camera.filterNames.4: a photometric band name (B, V, R, I)
entries.map:camera.filterNamesIr.0: a photometric band name (J, H, K)
entries.map:camera.filterNamesIr.1: a photometric band name (J, H, K)
entries.map:camera.filterNamesIr.2: a photometric band name (J, H, K)
entries.map:camera.accessReason.ready: empty in English too (no reason shown)
entries.map:camera.sourceWithHash: a label, SHA-256 and a hash prefix (no words)
entries.catalog:lss.exposure.elapsed: a parameter and a unit symbol ({ms} ms), the same in Spanish
entries.catalog:hubble.ratioColumn: a column header of symbols and units only (v/D · km/s/Mpc)
entries.catalog:ownResults.sha: a format name and the hash value (SHA-256 {sha256})
entries.original:Angstroms: the unit name, the same in Spanish usage (angstroms) as a plot axis caption
entries.original:ID #:: an identifier caption (ID and the number sign), the same in Spanish
entries.original:Dec:: the declination abbreviation Dec, kept as in the glossary (ascensión recta [AR] / declinación [Dec])
entries.original:Min: the minutes abbreviation, the same in Spanish (min)
entries.original:HH:MM:SS: a time format pattern, not words
entries.catalog:lss.dialog.jd: an identifier (JD, Julian Date) as a column header
entries.catalog:lss.dialog.dec: the coordinate abbreviation and its unit (Dec, °) as a column header
entries.catalog:lss.dialog.z: the redshift symbol (z) as a column header
entries.map:wedge.columns.index: the number sign as a column header (#)
entries.map:wedge.columns.dec: the coordinate abbreviation (Dec) as a column header
entries.map:wedge.columns.velocity: a symbol and its unit, V (km/s)
entries.map:wedge.sha256: a hash name kept in English (SHA-256)
entries.map:wedge.detail.velocity: a symbol and a number format (V binary32)
entries.map:wedge.detail.z: a symbol and a number format (Z binary32)
entries.catalog:ph.fixed: the photometric band letters and the telescope name (U / B / V · {telescope}), no words
entries.catalog:ph.seriesSecondsOption: a parameter and a unit symbol ({seconds} s), the same in Spanish
entries.catalog:pleiadesLab.sourceFile: a file name, its size in bytes and its SHA-256 ({name} · {bytes} bytes · SHA-256 {sha256}); «bytes» is the same in Spanish
entries.catalog:classLines.option: only placeholders, a unit and a separator ({wavelength} Å · {label})
entries.catalog:probe.shaLabel: a hash name kept in every language (SHA-256)
entries.catalog:photo.caption: only placeholders and a separator ({label} · {polarity})
entries.catalog:viewport.range: only placeholders, a unit and symbols ({minimum}–{maximum} Å · {zoom}×)
entries.catalog:nativeResults.storage.binary32: a Delphi type name and a bit count (Single · 32 bits)
entries.catalog:nativeResults.storage.binary64: a Delphi type name and a bit count (Double · 64 bits)
entries.map:pulsar.pulsar.panel.label: the same word in Spanish (Panel {n})

entries.map:pulsar.pulsar.review.blank: a dash for an empty cell
entries.map:pulsarSavedRows.savedRows.lineEnding: the file's own line-ending name (CR LF)

entries.map:radioAntenna.antenna.format.ra: a coordinate format (h m s), not words

entries.map:objectXLab.orbitNames.ObjX_AST.CMO: a file name with its source and year (ObjX_AST.CMO (Lowell, 2009))
entries.map:objectXLab.spectrumKeptRow: only placeholders, separators and the unit s ({label}: {telescope}, {seconds} s)
entries.map:objectXLab.imageRow: only placeholders, separators and the units UT and s ({label}: {ut} UT, {filter}, {seconds} s)
entries.map:objectXLab.datePlaceholder: a date and time in the typed format (2009-06-01T04:00:00)
entries.map:objectXLab.imageRowPlain: only placeholders and the unit UT ({label}: {ut} UT)
entries.map:objectXMeasure.cursor: the same words in Spanish (Cursor x {x}, y {y})
entries.map:objectXMeasure.colUt: a time scale symbol, kept as in the rest of the Spanish (UT)
